definition: far down, to a great depth
description: A first-person shot on a narrow concrete pier over bright turquoise sea. The person walks up to a round shaft in the concrete and looks straight down into it: a dark green mossy hole going far down out of sight. They lower themselves in and drop down the shaft, the walls rushing past, the round opening of daylight shrinking above their black trainers. At the bottom the shaft opens under water and they come out over pale sand with orange coral patches on the seabed, still looking down at their own feet.
